items.Sentence: The treatment at the Facility consists of influent pump stations, two partially aerated lagoons (Pond 1) and (Pond 2), an effluent holding pond (Pond 3), hypochlorite injection, and three sand filters.
Pond 1 is a combination aerated lagoon and facultative pond with an approximate capacity of 2.7 million gallons and 1.25 acres of surface area.
Pond 2 is a polishing pond with an estimated capacity of 1.5 million gallons and a surface area of 0.75 acres.
The Discharger maintains a 20-acre feet effluent storage lagoon where flow can be diverted prior to the sand filters.

The treatment at the Facility consists of influent pump stations, two partially aerated lagoons (Pond 1) and (Pond 2), an effluent holding pond (Pond 3), hypochlorite injection, and three sand filters.

Final treated effluent from the sand filters and/or Pond 3 is dechlorinated and discharged to an unnamed ephemeral drainageway that is a tributary to the Nacimiento River 4.2 miles downstream of the discharge point.

The spray irrigation fields, located at the former percolation ponds location, are currently being developed by the District based on the report “Spray Irrigation Field Work Plan” by HRCSD dated October 16, 2014.
In addition to the surface water discharge, the Discharger previously used percolation/evaporation ponds to dispose of approximately 18-21% of the overall effluent from the Facility.
